hook.name: V2Hook
hook.description: Launchpad hook that charges a fee on the numeraire leg via hook deltas (bypassing LP fee, which is overridden to zero). The fee decays linearly from a configurable start (up to 80%) to a steady-state end (default 1%) over a configurable window (default 10 s) to deter opening-block snipers; exactOut swaps revert during this window. Liquidity additions are vault-only; principal removals are permanently locked. Optionally gates buys to NFT holders and locks sells for a presale period.
